meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取、检查和写入流式细胞术FCS文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理FCS格式的流式细胞术数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry FCS files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能读取 FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 流式细胞术文件,提取事件为 NumPy 数组,查看通道与元数据,导出 CSV/DataFrame,并创建新的 FCS 3.1 文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求解析或检查 FCS 文件、提取流式细胞术事件为数组、导出或创建 FCS/CSV 时触发。

say.text: 读取这个 FCS 文件,显示版本、事件数和通道名。
say.note: Claude 会输出文件基本信息。

say.text: 把 FCS 事件转成 NumPy 数组,并告诉我数组形状。
say.note: 调用 as_array() 提取事件。

say.text: 用这个数组和通道名创建一个 FCS 3.1 文件。
say.note: 调用 create_fcs 生成新文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 flow cytometry files, extract events as NumPy arrays, inspect channels and metadata, export to CSV/DataFrame, and create new FCS 3.1 files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to parse or inspect FCS files, extract flow cytometry events as arrays, or export/create FCS/CSV files.

say_en.text: Read this FCS file and show version, event count, and channel names.
Convert FCS events to a NumPy array and tell me the shape.
Create an FCS 3.1 file from this array and channel names.
say_en.note: Calls create_fcs to generate a new file.
